description:
intent=i002 snapshot=s01 branch=pull-invalidates-pointer status=complete
finding location=net/802/garp.c:447-485 confidence=medium conclusion=garp_pdu_parse_attr() keeps ga=skb->data across pskb_may_pull(skb, ga->len) with the peer-chosen length, then reads ga->len/ga->event/ga->data through the stale pointer, a remotely reachable slab-UAF read on non-linear GARP PDUs (medium confidence).
finding location=drivers/net/ppp/ppp_generic.c:3091-3137 confidence=medium conclusion=ppp_ccp_peek() caches dp=skb->data+2, pulls a peer-chosen CCP length with pskb_may_pull(skb, len+2) that can free the head, then offsets and dereferences dp (CCP_OPT_LENGTH, decomp_init/comp_init), a peer-reachable slab-UAF read on non-linear CCP ConfAcks (medium confidence).
finding location=drivers/net/wan/hdlc_fr.c:940-969 confidence=low conclusion=fr_rx() reads data[3]/data[4] through a pointer saved before skb_share_check() can copy the head, so a cloned received FR frame yields a stale-head read plus unchecked skb_pull(4/5) linearization (low confidence; FRAD must deliver cloned/non-linear skbs).
unresolved location=drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/mei/net.c:428 conclusion=Read iwlwifi/mei/net.c iwl_mei_tx_copy_to_csme fully to check whether hdr is dereferenced after the pskb_pull and whether the TX skb can be non-linear (frag-backed) at that point.
unresolved location=drivers/bluetooth/btmtksdio.c:508 conclusion=Re-read drivers/bluetooth/btmtksdio.c btmtksdio_rx_packet() in full to check for sdio_hdr field reads after the pull and for non-linear RX skbs from the SDIO transport.
unresolved location=drivers/net/wireless/broadcom/brcm80211/brcmfmac/sdio.c:1874 conclusion=Re-read brcmfmac/sdio.c brcmf_sdio_rxglom() lines ~1698-1880 to confirm whether dptr survives a pull/linearization and whether glom RX skbs can be non-linear.
unresolved location=drivers/net/usb/ax88179_178a.c:1470 conclusion=Verify ax88179_178a.c rx_fixup re-derives pkt_hdr from skb->data after each skb_pull and that usbnet rx_fixup skbs are always linear (napi_alloc_coalesced/alloc_skb heads).
unresolved location=drivers/isdn/mISDN/layer2.c:1321 conclusion=Check whether mISDN layer2 receive skbs can be non-linear such that skb->data[i] reads at layer2.c:1320-1322 touch non-linear bytes (missing pull before read), distinct from the stale-pointer shape.
unresolved location=net/nfc/llcp_core.c:1401 conclusion=Determine whether any NFC driver delivers a non-linear skb to nfc_llcp_recv_agf and whether the pdu_len bytes and later skb->data reads are linear-guaranteed before the pull.
coverage_gap=Only the ~115 save/pull/use triples flagged by the structural scanner over the 227 pskb_may_pull-bearing .c files in net/ and drivers/ were triaged; lower-ranked files (e.g. drivers/net/wireless offload paths, net/ipv6 extension-header parsers flagged in earlier intents) were never line-read in s01.
coverage_gap=Bare skb_pull()/__skb_pull() callers (which cannot reallocate but can move skb->data and invalidate saved data pointers, a weaker variant of the branch) were only sampled, not enumerated exhaustively in s01.
coverage_gap=The six unresolved candidates (iwlwifi mei, btmtksdio, brcmfmac sdio, ax88179, mISDN layer2, nfc llcp_agf) remain unclassified because per-driver skb non-linearity/cloning behavior could not be settled from the snapshot alone.
coverage_gap=No runtime KASAN build or reproducer was produced for garp_pdu_parse_attr, ppp_ccp_peek, or fr_rx, so head reallocation on non-linear input is inferred from __pskb_pull_tail's reallocation branch (net/core/skbuff.c) rather than observed.
limitation=All findings are source-reading hypotheses: triggering requires a non-linear skb so pskb_may_pull/pskb_pull_tail actually reallocates and frees the old head; for already-linear heads the pull is a no-op and the code is merely fragile.
limitation=The garp finding's stale reads are bounded (2-4 bytes of freed head per dereference) and constitute a UAF read (infoleak/crash) rather than a write; whether any driver configuration delivers non-linear GARP PDUs into garp_pdu_rcv was not audited.
limitation=The ppp finding requires a PPP channel that hands non-linear skbs into ppp_input and a peer-negotiated CCP ConfAck while (SC_CCP_OPEN|SC_CCP_UP) == SC_CCP_OPEN; reachability per channel driver (pppoe/pppox/pppol2tp vs async) was not audited.
limitation=The hdlc_fr finding depends on the FRAD delivering a cloned skb at skb_share_check and/or non-linear bytes; many WAN drivers build fresh linear skbs, in which case the data pointer stays valid and the finding is latent, hence low confidence.
limitation=The scanner's function-extent heuristic (column-0 braces) and single-line derivation matching can mis-scope large functions and miss multi-line pointer derivations, so false negatives among the several hundred pull call sites in s01 cannot be excluded.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque; all line numbers and code state are valid only for snapshots/s01 as supplied, and no git history, network access, or cross-snapshot comparison was used per assignment constraints.
